newsitem.title: CANADA: Ulster Pete plans to sell 4 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Ulster Pete plans to sell 4 mln shares.

text.p: Ulster Petroleums Ltd said on Monday it had retained a syndicate of underwriters to sell about four million shares through a fully marketed public offering.

It said a preliminary short form prospectus in connection with the offering was filed in Canada on December 6. The exact number and price of the shares would be decided withing the next two weeks, following the marketing of the issue.
Net proceeds will be used to fund Ulster's exploration and development programs in 1997 and 1998. Until required for this, funds would be used to reduce bank debt.
